title: Towards Mitigating Excessive Forgetting in LLM Unlearning via Entanglement-Guidance with Proxy Constraint
abstract: arXiv:2508.20443v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are trained on massive datasets that may include private or copyrighted content. Due to growing privacy and ownership concerns, data owners may request the removal of their data from trained models. Machine unlearning provides a practical solution by removing the influence of specific data without full retraining. However, most existing methods still suffer from over-unlearning due to the lack of a principled mechanism to regulate the forgetting boundary, leading to unnecessary utility degradation and heightened privacy and robustness risks. In this work, we propose EGUP (Entanglement-Guided Unlearning with Proxy Constraint), a novel framework that leverages entanglement and proxy constraint to guide the unlearning process while mitigating over-unlearning. translated_title: 通过纠缠引导与代理约束缓解大语言模型遗忘中的过度遗忘问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2508.20443v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）在海量数据集上进行训练，这些数据集可能包含私人或受版权保护的内容。出于对隐私和所有权的日益关注，数据所有者可能会要求从已训练的模型中删除其数据。机器遗忘（Machine Unlearning）通过在不进行完全重新训练的情况下移除特定数据的影响，提供了一种实用的解决方案。然而，由于缺乏一种有原则的机制来调节遗忘边界，大多数现有方法仍然存在过度遗忘的问题，导致不必要的性能下降以及更高的隐私和鲁棒性风险。在这项工作中，我们提出了EGUP（基于代理约束的纠缠引导遗忘，Entanglement-Guided Unlearning with Proxy Constraint），这是一个新颖的框架，利用纠缠和代理约束来引导遗忘过程，同时缓解过度遗忘。在每次迭代中，EGUP采用样本间纠缠来自适应地重新加权遗忘强度，将更大的遗忘力度分配给f……
tldr: 提出EGUP框架，利用样本间纠缠和代理约束自适应调节遗忘强度，在实现大语言模型数据遗忘的同时有效缓解过度遗忘导致的性能下降和隐私鲁棒性风险。
en_tdlr: EGUP, a novel LLM unlearning framework that leverages inter-sample entanglement and proxy constraints to adaptively regulate unlearning strength, mitigating excessive forgetting and utility degradation while removing targeted data influence.
